            <title><![CDATA[What to know about the Kelvin wave raising the sea level along the West Coast]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/science/a-pulse-of-warm-water-hitting-the-pacific-coast-could-mean-erosion-and-flooding</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Kelvin waves are not like tsunamis, and they don't curl over and crash on the beach. A better image is water sloshing in the bathtub or a swimming pool during an earthquake. In the ocean, they are bulges of water that lift the sea level as they move along the coast.]]></description>
